body: Existing Updates now open as readable append-only records with an active read/unread control. Focus decision rows expose the report ID and open the report instead of its subject project; multiple decisions about one project remain separate. Full Linux gate, all 11 release Chromium regression suites, broad HTTPS smoke on retry, and planning browser check pass. Linux and Mac Mini release hosts now return HTTP 200 and expose the decision report ID; Mac web and Rust release builds pass. No physical iPhone or Safari check was made.

metadata.summary: Update detail modal and Focus decision navigation verified
